# SyncScribe

> SyncScribe (https://syncscribe.cc/) is a web-based AI subtitle generator. Drop in a video or audio file, pick languages, and download SRT and VTT subtitles. The video never leaves your device: audio is extracted in the browser with WebAssembly and only the audio track is uploaded.

## Features

- Output: SRT and VTT for every selected language, or an MKV with the subtitle tracks embedded (soft subtitles, muxed in the browser).
- Languages: 55 languages for transcription, with automatic language detection. Any supported language can be added as a translation target.
- Inputs: MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, M4V video; MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, WMA, Opus audio. Multi-audio-track files let you choose the track.
- Automatic name correction: SyncScribe identifies the show or film from the file name, embedded title and dialogue (no user input), looks up its character/place names, and fixes misheard ones, applying only corrections backed by that reference data. Unrecognized audio (home videos, lectures) is left as transcribed.
- Speed: most files process in a few minutes. Feature-length files are supported.
- Sharing: finished jobs get a permalink.

## Pricing

- Pay-as-you-go credits; 1 credit = 1 minute of audio. Credits never expire.
- Each extra translation language costs half a credit per minute of audio.
- 10 free minutes on signup, no credit card required.
- Credit packs (USD): Single $9.99 (120 minutes), Season $24.99 (400 minutes), Studio $74.99 (1,500 minutes).

## Account

- Sign in with Google.
- Support and API / enterprise inquiries: syncscribe@1379.tech

## Notes

- Subtitles are generated by AI and may contain errors; review before distributing.
